ValidationRule.description: There should always be at least one Log a Call record before lead can be closed. Even in cases when we're not calling the lead, task must be logged, to record why - i.e. duplicate or trade we dont cover.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT(
OR(
$User.Username = "integration@admiral.com", $User.Alias = 'autoproc'
)),
ISBLANK(Lead_Outcome_Retired__c),
OR( ISPICKVAL( Status ,"Converted"), ISPICKVAL( Status ,"Closed - Not Converted") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: It seems you are either missing Log a Call task or Callback Arrangement hasn't been closed
